clue.text: A sparkling side, Spain, in truth

indicators.note: the Spain letter sits within the word for truth, so 'in' places one inside the other

parts.note: a truth is a fact
E is the international vehicle registration for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: A romantic notion that Spain's dazzling aspect is the real truth.
explanation.definitionFit: Each flat polished face of a cut gem is a facet, the side that makes it sparkle.

clue.text: One short drink in football club to get in before the start of some hot food

indicators.note: the first 'in' puts the one and the shortened drink inside the club letters

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: a short drink here is one that has lost its last letter

parts.note: shandy is beer mixed with lemonade, a British pub drink
to be hip is to be in, fashionable

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word some is all that is taken

explanation.surface: Someone at a football club downs a quick drink before getting stuck into a hot meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' drops the last letter of the drink, beer and lemonade in a British pub. Fish and chips is the classic British takeaway, so 'hot food' fits.
explanation.definitionFit: Battered fish served with fried potatoes is the archetypal British hot takeaway meal.

clue.text: Scam that gets two men found guilty

parts.note: a con is a swindle or scam
Vic is a man's name, short for Victor
Ted is a man's name, short for Edward

explanation.surface: A fraud scheme gets a pair of men a guilty verdict.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a defendant convicted in court has been pronounced guilty of the charge.

clue.text: The skin problem he dismissed as nonsense

indicators.note: the word he is sent away from the phrase built before it, so dismissed signals a removal

parts.note: a rash is an outbreak of red spots on the skin

explanation.surface: A doctor brushes off a skin complaint as rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dismissed' takes HE out of THE RASH, leaving T + RASH.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: rubbish talk or worthless writing is called trash.

clue.text: Foothold established by Nonconformist church in stage of development

indicators.note: the church letters are placed within the word for a stage, signalled by 'in'

parts.note: a phase is a stage in a process
URC is the United Reformed Church, a British Nonconformist denomination

explanation.surface: A Nonconformist congregation gains a foothold in some phase of growth.
explanation.walkthrough: The URC (United Reformed Church) is a Protestant church in Britain outside the Church of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Purchase can mean a firm grip or hold, as in getting purchase on a slippery rock.

clue.text: Proper stars feature at the start of the US electoral process

definitions.text: feature at the start of the US electoral process

parts.note: prim means stiffly proper and correct
Aries is a constellation of stars, the Ram

explanation.surface: Prim celebrities appear early in the American election campaign.
explanation.definitionFit: Party contests choosing presidential candidates open each US election cycle, before the general election.

clue.text: Split the cost

definitions.meaning: a split or tear in fabric
the regular payment a tenant makes for use of a property

explanation.definitionFit: Rent is both a tear in cloth and money paid periodically to a landlord.

clue.text: Old culture of torment associated with working mines

parts.note: hell is a state of torment

indicators.note: working suggests the letters of mines being worked into a new order

explanation.surface: An ancient society linked with misery and mining.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working' shuffles the mines; 'Old culture' points to ancient Greece rather than any modern society.
explanation.definitionFit: Hellenism is the culture and civilisation of ancient Greece.

clue.text: Ropy stuff is offered in shop's special promotion for the most part

indicators.note: the word is is offered up inside the shortened promotion word
most of the word is kept, with its final letter lost

parts.note: a sale is a shop's promotion with reduced prices

explanation.surface: Rope is going cheap in a shop's discount event.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for the most part' drops the final letter of the shop event; 'Ropy' is a pun on rope-like, not shoddy.
explanation.definitionFit: Sisal is a plant fibre used for making rope and twine.

clue.text: Animated salesman is into overdramatic presentation

indicators.note: animated means set in lively motion, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A lively salesman enjoys hamming up his pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Sensationalism is presenting things in a lurid, exaggerated way to provoke excitement.

clue.text: Pretty morsel put out for bird

indicators.note: put out suggests the letters are disturbed and thrown out of order

explanation.surface: A nice titbit is left out for a bird to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: The storm petrel is a small seabird, an example of a bird.

clue.text: Sarcastic boss who'd be obsessed with LSD?

parts.note: acid remarks are biting and sarcastic
a head is the person in charge

explanation.surface: A sharp-tongued manager suspected of drug obsession.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang: an acidhead is a habitual user of LSD, the drug nicknamed acid.

clue.text: Opener for Essex will get in favourite shot

indicators.note: the opener and 'will' get inside the word for favourite

parts.note: a pet is a favourite

indicators.note: only the first letter of Essex is taken

parts.note: 'll is the contracted form of will

explanation.surface: An Essex opening batsman plays a favourite stroke.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is cricket, Essex being a county side and the opener a batsman; 'shot' is the gun pellet, not a stroke.
explanation.definitionFit: A pellet is a small piece of shot fired from a gun.

clue.text: Putting off financial problem, no bank initially admitted going wrong

indicators.note: no means without here, so the bank's first letter is not let in

parts.note: debt is a financial problem

indicators.note: the first letter of bank is the one meant

parts.note: erring means going wrong

explanation.surface: Someone postpones a money problem while the bank won't let them in, wrongly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no ... initially admitted' takes B out of DEBT, leaving DET, then ERRING.
explanation.definitionFit: Deterring is discouraging someone, putting them off acting.

clue.text: Mental activity of each boy in group

indicators.note: the each and boy pieces go inside the word for group

parts.note: a ring is a group, such as a spy ring
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: Each lad in a gang has some thinking to do.
explanation.definitionFit: Reasoning is the process of thinking logically, a form of mental activity.

clue.text: Something fruity from Graham censor suppressed

indicators.note: the censor word is pressed down within the novelist's surname

parts.note: Graham Greene was an English novelist
to gag is to censor

explanation.surface: A novelist's work is hushed up by a censor.
explanation.walkthrough: The gag goes inside GREENE: GREEN-GAG-E.
explanation.definitionFit: A greengage is a green variety of plum, so an example of fruit.

clue.text: Suffer from invasions, not half

indicators.note: half of the word for invasions is dropped, the back half here

parts.note: incursions are invasions or raids

explanation.surface: Being on the receiving end of raids, though only partly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not half' keeps the first five of the ten letters of INCURSIONS.
explanation.definitionFit: To incur a loss or penalty is to suffer or bring it upon oneself.

clue.text: Signed agreement attached to ribbon held by queen?

indicators.note: the attached-to and ribbon words are held inside the queen word

parts.note: a queen is a female cat; the question mark flags the non-royal sense
on can mean attached to, as a picture on a wall
a cord is a string or ribbon

explanation.surface: A treaty fastened with ribbon is kept by the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: A queen is a female cat, not a monarch here, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A concordat is a formal agreement, especially between the Vatican and a state.

clue.text: Henry, totally heartless and ultimately wicked king, a monster

indicators.note: all of the middle of Henry is removed, leaving its outer letters
the last letter of wicked is the one taken

parts.note: R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: King Henry was cruel and wicked, a real monster.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hydra is the many-headed monster slain by Hercules in Greek myth.

clue.text: Some needy drunk in the capital to begin with

indicators.note: drunk suggests these letters are staggering about out of order

explanation.surface: A few poor people are sozzled in the city.
explanation.definitionFit: Seed money is the initial capital used to start a business.

clue.text: Slaughter brute briefly in short ceremony

indicators.note: the shortened brute goes inside the shortened ceremony
the ceremony word loses its last letter

parts.note: pomp is ceremonial display

indicators.note: the brute word is cut short by a letter

parts.note: an ogre is a brutal monster

explanation.surface: A brutal killing during a short ceremony.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' and 'briefly' each lop one final letter; 'Slaughter' is a noun here, a massacre.
explanation.definitionFit: A pogrom is an organised massacre of a persecuted group.

clue.text: Savage is given new starter — liquid grub

indicators.note: the first letter of the savage word is replaced with a different one

parts.note: cruel means savage

explanation.surface: A savage gets a new first course of soup.
explanation.walkthrough: CRUEL changes its first letter to make GRUEL.
explanation.definitionFit: Gruel is a thin porridge, a watery food.

clue.text: Almost recognise bear in gap in the wood

indicators.note: almost all of the word is kept, its final letter lost

parts.note: to know someone is to recognise them
thole is an old and Scots word meaning to bear or endure

explanation.surface: Nearly identifying a bear in a woodland clearing.
explanation.walkthrough: THOLE (endure) is dialect; 'Almost' trims KNOW to KNO.
explanation.definitionFit: A knothole is a hole in timber where a knot has fallen out.

clue.text: Idiot we encountered during journey putting one off

indicators.note: the we letters appear in the middle of the shortened journey
putting one off means losing a letter for one
off completes the removal: the one letter goes

parts.note: a trip is a journey
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A fool we met on a trip put everyone off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'putting ... off' removes the Roman one from the journey; 'Idiot' is the definition, not the person met.
explanation.definitionFit: A twerp is a silly or foolish person.

clue.text: Wreck's sunk into ground, obviously

indicators.note: the answer is sunk into the words that follow

explanation.surface: A shipwreck is plainly buried in the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: To undo something is to ruin or destroy it, as in undone by scandal.

clue.text: A rude call in January shortly diverted — it doesn't fit in with our current timetables

definitions.text: it doesn't fit in with our current timetables

indicators.note: diverted means turned aside, so the letters are sent off in another order

parts.note: Jan is the short form of January

explanation.surface: A rude phone call in January is rerouted and spoils the schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: The Julian calendar was superseded by the Gregorian, the system now used for dates.

clue.text: Last bit of soap on ear — something you may see in bath

definitions.text: something you may see in bath

indicators.note: only the final letter of soap is taken

parts.note: lughole is British slang for ear

explanation.surface: Soap suds end up on someone's ear in the bath.
explanation.walkthrough: Lughole is British slang for the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: A plughole is the drain opening in a bath or sink.

clue.text: Flowery bit found in park with others

parts.note: P is the map abbreviation for park
et al is Latin for and others

explanation.surface: A bit of a flower is found in the park along with others.
explanation.definitionFit: A petal is one of the coloured parts of a flower.
